data_description.url: The HTTP or HTTPS address of the assist-live server. Use TLS or an isolated network.
data_description.token: The integration token from the server. The token must have access to the satellite keys.
data_description.fallback_stt: The standard STT entity that HA uses when it cannot use the server. An assist-live entity cannot be a fallback.
data_description.fallback_tts: The standard TTS entity that HA uses when it cannot use the server. An assist-live entity cannot be a fallback.
data_description.notify_tts_failure: If on, HA shows the full reply text in a notification after a TTS failure.
data_description.local_only: If on, HA uses the server only when server health reports local destinations. HA also refuses a cloud fallback. Set local_only on the server too.
data_description.record_transcripts: If on, the server can store the last transcript of a turn. The server policy must also let the server store it. The default is off.
data_description.fallback_stt_local: If on, HA records the fallback STT entity as local when HA cannot find its destination. Do this only after you examine that integration.
data_description.fallback_tts_local: If on, HA records the fallback TTS entity as local when HA cannot find its destination. Do this only after you examine that integration.

http_warning.title: HTTP sends the access token without encryption
http_warning.description: Use TLS or an isolated network. Continue only if this HTTP server is on an isolated network.

data_description.pipeline_select: The pipeline selector entity of the same device.
data_description.add_another: If on, the next step adds one more satellite. Use no more than five satellites with one token.

init.title: Fallback engines, destination checks, and transcript storage
init.description: With local only on, HA uses server STT or TTS only when health reports local_only on and a local destination for that part. If a check is unsatisfactory, HA uses the fallback. HA does not use an older server without these fields. HA also checks fallback destinations and speaker events. These configured-destination checks are not a firewall. These checks do not include the conversation agent.

unknown_tts_voice.title: The server refused a TTS voice
unknown_tts_voice.description: The server refused voice {voice} for {entity}. Select an available server voice in the pipeline or TTS request. The fallback uses its own voice. This issue clears after a satisfactory request with that voice or when a subsequent server voice list includes it.

speaker_destination.title: The server reported a cloud speaker destination
speaker_destination.description: HA received a cloud speaker result with the local-only option on. Check the server local_only setting. HA cannot stop the server request. The transcript did not change.

invalid_stored_state.title: Invalid stored turn data
invalid_stored_state.description: The integration dropped invalid stored entries. Valid entries stay available. Check HA storage and restart the integration after the storage check. No transcript or token is in this issue.

event_stream_unavailable.title: Satellite event subscription cannot continue
event_stream_unavailable.description: The event subscription for {satellite} has repeated failures. Check the server event stream and HA storage. The integration retries with a maximum 30 s interval. It does not skip a refused event.

fallback_stt_unavailable.title: Fallback STT entity unavailable
fallback_stt_unavailable.description: The fallback engine {entity} is not available. Check its integration or select an available standard STT entity. A turn that must use this engine gives fallback_unavailable. This issue clears on the next engine lookup or maintenance health read after recovery.

fallback_tts_unavailable.title: Fallback TTS entity unavailable
fallback_tts_unavailable.description: The fallback engine {entity} is not available. Check its integration or select an available entity-backed standard TTS engine. Legacy provider names cannot supply this fallback. A turn that must use this engine gives fallback_unavailable. This issue clears on the next engine lookup or maintenance health read after recovery.

server_unavailable.title: assist-live server unavailable
server_unavailable.description: Check the server URL, access token, and server status. Standard engines supply fallback speech while the server is unavailable.

shared_pipeline.title: Satellites share an assist-live pipeline
shared_pipeline.description: Select a different assist-live pipeline for each satellite. Shared pipelines cannot identify the correct satellite for each turn. See the setup instructions.
